title: MV Yanfly Animated SV Enemies and Action Sequence not animating properly

posts.author: Seda
posts.body:
Hello all, I am using Yanfly's SVEnemies and Action Sequences 1-3 plugins and am having difficulties getting certain animations to run in my attack animation. Another plugin worth noting is Yanfly's CTB combat system.
I've checked 3 different discord channels for support, as well as watched Yanfly's videos on the plugins, checked around Reddit and tried to modify someone elses animation sequence, and even went to Vibrato's site (From the Yanfly "Beautiful Vibrato Battlers" post on his site) to see how they animate their characters to see if I was missing something and I cannot seem to figure out this issue (though, I did learn a few new tricks
).
The Action Sequence I am trying to work out is my basic "Attack" action. The attacker is supposed to move to their target using their walk animation, perform their swing animation and deal damage, then return home while performing their "Evade" animation.
The problem I am running into is when I try to force the walking animation (Motion walk: user), the character does the walk animation, but then goes back into their neutral animation before moving to the targets base.  The rest of the animation plays out perfectly though.
How do I get it so that the walking animation plays WHILE the character is moving to the target's base?

posts.body:
Just to clarify.
Seda said:
The problem I am running into is when I try to force the walking animation (Motion walk: user), the character does the walk animation, but then goes back into their neutral animation before moving to the targets base. The rest of the animation plays out perfectly though.
Click to expand...
what motion exactly are you expecting? the very top left one on a standard battler sheet, right? the walk motion is the "neutral" motion, so if calling for the walk motion resulted in a different one playing, then there is likely either some confusion or a plugin installed that changes things
in a project with just yanfly's core, battle engine core, the 3 action sequence plugins, and animated enemies plugin, the skill works as expected. for visibility, the walk motion has red painted over it and the blue is for the physical action ready motion. Once the AS starts and the sprite leaves the ready motion it only does the walk. Can you confirm the same if you removed all other plugins?
The skill is the exact one in the last response

Holy Moly! This made me start digging up stuff and questioning if my assets were set up correctly. As it turns out, the template I was using for the side view battlers was a japanese one that was translated to english. The english translation was incorrect for the "Ready" animation and called it "Walk". I was opperating under the assumption that the Yanfly's engine for "motion walk: user" was calling sprites from what I thought was the walk position on the sprite sheet, but I was actually putting my movement animation into the "Ready" animations on the sprite sheet. I adjusted my sprite sheet, and just on a whim switched my movement animation on the sprite sheet over to the missile position, used "Motion missile: user" instead of "motion walk: user" before and after the "Move user: target base" and it all worked out!
Issue resolved, and all is well. Thank YOU Robro33 SO MUCH for the assistance! I've been banging my head against a wall for 3 weeks trying to figure this out!!
